result.title: Legal Notice Demanding Return of Rental Security Deposit
result.body:
[Sender's Name / Tenant's Full Name]
[Sender's Address]

Date: [Date of Notice]

To,
[Landlord's Full Name]
[Landlord's Address]

Subject: Legal Notice for Return of Security Deposit of INR 20,000 for Property Located in Pune, Maharashtra

1. That on 1 March 2025, a written 11-month agreement was signed between you ([Landlord's Full Name]) and me ([Sender's Name]) for the rental property located in Pune, Maharashtra.

2. That pursuant to the said agreement, I paid a security deposit of ₹20,000 via bank transfer.

3. That I completely vacated the apartment and handed over the keys to you on 30 April 2026.

4. That despite the vacation of the premises and peaceful handing over of possession, you have failed and neglected to return the security deposit amount of ₹20,000, have given no reason for withholding the same, and have stopped answering my calls.

5. That under the terms of our rental agreement and applicable legal principles, I am entitled to the immediate refund of the security deposit of ₹20,000 upon vacating the premises.

I hereby demand that you return the full security deposit of ₹20,000 within [placeholder days] days from the receipt of this notice.

In the event of your failure to return the security deposit within the stipulated time, I reserve the right to pursue available legal remedies, including approaching the civil court or utilizing mechanisms such as District Legal Services Authority mediation, as permissible under law.

Enclosures:
1. Copy of the written 11-month agreement
2. Bank transfer receipt for the deposit
3. Copies of WhatsApp chats

Sincerely,

[Sender's Name]
[Sender's Contact Number]
